sentences.text: This appeal is filed by the claimant under Section 173(1) of Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 (hereinafter referred to as 'MV Act' for short) challenging the judgment and award dated 25.07.2013 passed in MVC No.136/2011 on the file of the Additional Senior Civil Judge MACT, Srirangapatna, seeking enhancement of the compensation.
2. The factum of accident and injuries sustained by the claimant in the accident are not in dispute.

3. Heard the arguments on both the sides and perused the material on records.
NC: 2024:KHC:51079 4.
The Tribunal has granted the compensation under various heads as follows:

Sl . Particulars Amount (in.Rs.) No.
1. Pain and suffering 25,000.00 2. Loss of future earning capacity 48,600.00 3.
Medical expenses 38,000.00 4. Loss of earnings during laid up 15,000.00 period 5. Loss of amenities 20,000.00 6.
Diet and attendant charges 20,000.00

sentences.text: 5. The Tribunal while determining the compensation has not adopted the correct parameters.
Hence, the claimant is entitled for compensation.
6. From the medical evidence, it is proved that the claimant has sustained fracture of left leg and ankle confirmed malleolar fracture with subluxation.
7. Considering the nature of the injuries sustained by the claimant, the compensation amount awarded under NC: 2024:KHC:51079 the head 'pain and suffering' is on the lower side.
Therefore, a sum of Rs.35,000/- is enhanced under the said head.
The compensation awarded under the head 'medical expenses' is as per the medical bills produced by the claimant and therefore, the same is kept in tact.
8. The Tribunal has erred in taking notional income at Rs.3,000/-.
The accident was caused in the year 2010.
Therefore, a sum of Rs.5,500/- is to be taken into consideration as recognized by the Karnataka State Legal Services Authority.
Considering the nature of injuries sustained, the doctor has assessed 9% of disability.
The claimant is aged 38 years.
Therefore, the appropriate multiplier applicable is '15'.

Therefore, the loss of future earnings due to disability is hereby re-assessed and quantified as under:
Rs.5,500 x 9/100 x 15 x 12 = Rs.89,100/-

Accordingly, a sum of Rs.89,100/- is awarded under the head 'loss of future earnings due to disability'.
NC: 2024:KHC:51079 9.
The Tribunal has awarded compensation of Rs.20,000/- under the heads 'loss of amenities' which is on the lesser side.
Therefore, a sum of Rs.25,000/- is awarded under the said head.
Further, the Tribunal has awarded compensation of Rs.20,000/- under the head 'incidental expenses' which is on the higher side.
The same is reduced to Rs.15,000/- under the said head.
The compensation granted under the head 'loss of earning during laid up period' is kept in tact.

10. Thus, in all, the claimant is entitled for the following sums:
Sl. Particulars Amount (in.Rs.) No.
1. Pain and suffering 35,000.00 2. Loss of future earnings due to 89,100.00 disability 3.
Medical expenses 38,000.00 4. Loss of earnings during laid up 15,000.00 period Smt K D Anusuya vs K V Yogesh on 10 December, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/164983760/

sentences.text: 3 5. Loss of amenities 25,000.00 NC: 2024:KHC:51079 6.
Diet and attendant charges 15,000.00
The Tribunal has awarded the compensation of Rs.1,66,600/-, but the appellant/claimant is entitled to total compensation of Rs.2,17,100/-.

Therefore, the appellant/claimant is entitled to enhanced compensation of Rs.50,500/- (Rs.2,17,100 - Rs.1,66,600) with interest at the rate of 6%
p.a. from the date of petition till realization, in addition to what has been awarded by the Tribunal.
12.

Accordingly, I proceed to pass the following:
ORDER i.
The appeal is allowed-in-part.

ii. The judgment and award passed by the Tribunal in MVC No.136/2011 dated 25.07.2013 by the Court of Additional Senior Civil Judge, MACT, Srirangapatna, is hereby modified holding that the claimant is entitled for enhanced compensation of Rs.50,500/- along with interest @ 6% p.a.,
from the date of petition till its realization, in addition to what has been awarded by the Tribunal.

sentences.text: The appellant/claimant is not entitled for the interest for the delayed period of 369 days in filing the appeal.

iv. Costs made easy.
v. Ordered accordingly.
vi.
The other observations and findings of the Tribunal  are kept in tact.

SD/-
